name: Hideaway Day Camp
description_short: Traditional day camp since 1961 on 72 acres along the Skippack Creek near Valley Forge Park, for ages 5 to 14. Every group has a swim lesson each morning, then rotates through ropes courses, rock wall and zip line, canoeing and fishing, mini golf, archery, drama, crafts, nature study and creek walks.
refund_policy_summary: Written cancellation before March 1 refunds everything, including the $300 deposit; March 1 to April 1 refunds all but the deposit. Full payment due April 1, with no refunds after. Up to two weeks can be cancelled before April 1 without penalty; each further cancelled week costs $100. Switching weeks is free if space allows.
special_needs_notes: Hideaway tries to meet campers' special needs; one on one or wraparound support must be arranged with the office before camp starts.
swim_waterfront_notes: Every group has a mandatory swim lesson each morning; optional free swim in the afternoon for campers who took the lesson.
notes: 2027 rates: 1 to 3 weeks $560 per week without transportation; 4 weeks $2,240, 5 weeks $2,750, 6 weeks $3,240, 7 weeks $3,710, 8 weeks $4,160, including school bus from a central stop in the serving area. $25 per week off for 4 or more weeks with own transportation; sibling discounts $15 to $25 per week. $300 deposit at registration goes toward tuition. Camp day 9:30 to 3:10; free before care from 8 AM and after care to 4:30. Campers must have finished Pre-K or K and be 5 by May 1, up to 8th grade completed. Bus stops in Collegeville, Audubon, Berwyn, Eagleville, King of Prussia, Phoenixville, Royersford, Trappe and Trooper.
